title: Oak Hill Montessori third grade ranks No. 2 in 2024-25 mathematics MCA participation
text:
Oak Hill Montessori third grade ranks No. 2 in 2024-25 mathematics MCA participation
V. D. Gordon
The third-grade cohort at Oak Hill Montessori Community School achieved the second highest participation rate in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA, data from the Minnesota Department of Education shows.
Out of 109 students who completed the mathematics assessment at Oak Hill Montessori Community School, 20 were third-graders.
In total, 50% of the third-grade group reached mathematics proficiency as defined by the assessment criteria.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state tests administered to evaluate student progress toward Minnesota standards and to satisfy federal and state laws. Exams include topics in math, reading, and science, depending on the grade. Most test-takers complete the MCA, but students who qualify for special education services may participate in the Alt MCA if they meet the criteria.
The state's MCA proficiency rates have dropped below pre-pandemic benchmarks, according to Minnesota's Report Card. For math, proficiency decreased by over 7% compared to 2019, and reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in mathematics |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 20 | 50% |
| 4th | 18 | 72% |
| 5th | 19 | 21% |
| 6th | 19 | 32% |
| 7th | 16 | 56% |
| 8th | 17 | 53% |
Details in this article are sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education. The full dataset is available here.
